title: Radiant
notes: Physical ARM64 smoke test on 2026-10-09, IPA SHA-256 ED119FEA93FC65845795F1BD71D48DF12FE5B45C6A12FA7E2CC7AD505D911A4C. Main menu, difficulty selection, tutorial and first live space-shooter scene render. Taps navigate into the scene and dismiss the tutorial. Movement, shooting, audio, saves and sustained gameplay were not tested.

testedOn.appBuild: Super Duper Debug, tree f8d2fecb, APK SHA-256 B12DD556EB86270E33E5DC4AD31356CABB774C9D6BAFD2E62F7B0F59581DEAA4

reviewedUserReports.notes: POCO M2007J20CG (Android 12, ARM64/Adreno 618), Super Duper Release f8d2fecb. Exact IPA SHA-256 verified. Cold launch reaches main menu, difficulty selection, tutorial and a live shooter scene. Holding the left/right screen halves moves the ship both directions; the ship visibly auto-fires and score rose 85 to 265. In-game emulator pause froze an identical frame across 4 seconds; Continue resumed changing frames. This is an initial playable interaction, not a full-game pass. Acoustic sound, level progression, ordinary saves, long-session stability and additional device profiles remain unverified.
